name: aipe
description: Spec workflow for AI-assisted development. 35 disciplined slash commands across three flows — action (Describe → Diagnose → Act), reflective (Evaluate, Teach + Rehearse + Read), and readiness (Recon → Drill). Four orchestrators that run their families in one pass. Study family (1 orchestrator + 16 generators): /aipe:study, /aipe:study-system-design, /aipe:study-software-design, /aipe:study-frontend-engineering, /aipe:study-data-modeling, /aipe:study-security, /aipe:study-testing, /aipe:study-runtime-systems, /aipe:study-networking, /aipe:study-database-systems, /aipe:study-dsa-foundations, /aipe:study-distributed-systems, /aipe:study-debugging-observability, /aipe:study-performance-engineering, /aipe:study-ai-engineering, /aipe:study-agent-architecture, /aipe:study-prompt-engineering. Rehearse family (1 orchestrator + 4 generators): /aipe:rehearse, /aipe:rehearse-problem-selection, /aipe:rehearse-design-doc, /aipe:rehearse-hackathon-demo, /aipe:rehearse-interview-defense. Readiness family (1 orchestrator + 2 generators): /aipe:ready, /aipe:recon, /aipe:drill — measures hireability on the AI-engineering ladder and closes the highest-leverage gap with a hands-on failure-rep. Audit family (1 orchestrator + 4 generators): /aipe:audit, /aipe:audit-status, /aipe:audit-cleanup, /aipe:audit-frontend-a11y, /aipe:audit-refactor — take stock of a project (what is, what's wrong, what's inaccessible, what an engineer would say). Plus /aipe:refactor (+ 2 refactor variants), /aipe:read-aposd, and /aipe:code-review for per-branch PR reviews. Uses your agent's own model, no external CLI, no extra API keys.
